head.name: Lit Index
what: giant condensed title with folio number and rule under it; or serif title with a typed count
folio plus one giant condensed word with the lede on its baseline; or a typed count standing on the masthead rule

head.name: Swiss Thread
what: large two-line question with the one lit word, date on the right, composer straight below

head.name: Track Diagram Aglow, merged
what: Serif page title with a page-coloured count and a small unit label standing on the title rule

glass.name: Long Persistence Tallied, merged
what: tube with a scope trace of plans as pulses and a NOW marker, with a mono status line on the glass

glass.name: Grid Console, merged
what: Monitor in a thin bezel with scan-lit radar, Next up and a typed line, set on a bloom; the scope with a trace is the runner

glass.name: Desk Terminal, Dialled
what: Vera's typed question, Next up and trend or dial all in one VT323 tube with a cursor

list.name: Track Diagram Aglow, merged
what: To do as a dated spine: a left Due margin, nodes on a rail and a lit NOW; the runner is the day-numeral cards with a NOW tick
To do as a dated spine: date margin, rail nodes, task plates, lit NOW node

list.name: Track Diagram Aglow, merged
what: To do as a dated spine with nodes and a lit NOW; faint alternate-row band as a runner

figure.name: Grid Console Ledger Dial
what: Moving-coil spend dial with lit sector and LIMIT flag, in a bezelled glowing tube

figure.name: Desk Terminal, Dialled
what: moving-coil spend dial drawn in phosphor on the Status tube

rule.name: Grid Console, merged
what: Section heads on a lit hairline with node ends and corner-tabbed trays

rule.name: Phosphor Blueprint, merged
what: ruled section heads with coloured ends, hatched kind swatches and a title block; or a lit thread with nodes

rule.name: Grid Console, merged
what: Section head as a serif title and icon on a thin rail in the section's colour

signal.name: Track Diagram Aglow, merged
what: one status line under the question (Listening, watching 4 plans) with a lit dot

signal.name: Desk Terminal, Banded, merged
what: lamp-row status dots (lit and hollow) with dotted leaders; white-hot pilot lamp on the title block

signal.name: Grid Console, merged
what: Glowing NOW stamp with a live clock on the lit thread, and haloed status lamps

type.name: Lit Index
what: wide-range condensed display with a lit key word over small mono labels; or serif headings over mono labels

type.name: Grid Console, merged
what: Serif page titles over mono small labels and a grotesque body; the runner is the condensed display with a lit word

colour.name: Grid Console, merged
what: Teal-black ground with grounded section hues (amber, steel blue, mauve) as thin edges; cool slate with cream text as the runner

colour.name: Blueprint, Cream Ink
what: warm cream ink and sage and cyan companions on a teal-black ground; or blue-grey slate plates

controls.name: Phosphor Blueprint, merged
what: numbered ruled select list with a tick, fused composer row with square Send, dashed arrow chips

controls.name: Desk Terminal, Banded, merged
what: Raised keyed segmented filters with a lit radio dot and a bright primary Add button

chat.name: Track Diagram Aglow, merged
what: Thread hung from Vera's mark on a rail with times in the margin and a ring at the composer
one Vera card holding greeting, question, status line, composer and Send, with chips beneath

light.name: Lit Index
what: Raster-lined bloom on the key word and the primary key; the runner is a two-layer halo on live lead words only
scanlined glowing key word with a two-layer halo; lead-word halo on live list rows

light.name: Grid Console Single Line
what: three-layer halo on the one lit word 'mind' in the Home panel, bright Send, halo kept for the live word only

foot.name: Phosphor Blueprint, merged
what: uppercase tab bar with a lit top edge on the current tab

foot.name: Blueprint, Pilot Lamp
what: title-block footer (project, motto, drawn, sheet) with a pilot lamp on its top rule; or a pilot lamp in the console foot
